Chapter 645: Chapter 1: Land Beyond (5000 words, please subscribe)_2

For example, Lin Yuan, as the Galaxy Master, has quite a few followers and can be considered the rudiments of a power base.

“Master, should you next attempt to step into the Tenth Rank?” the Six-Armed Silhouette inquired tentatively.

Lin Yuan had already reached the pinnacle in all aspects at the Ninth Rank, surpassing what the Myriad Clans of the Main Universe had defined as the Ninth Stage Peak by an unknown margin.

If Lin Yuan wanted to greatly increase his strength now, the only way was to step into the Tenth Rank.

“Yes,” Lin Yuan nodded.

Now that the period of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm had concluded, stepping into the Tenth Rank indeed was Lin Yuan’s primary goal moving forward.

...

“Your Majesty once said that to become ultimate, one needs to fuse as many rules as possible at the Tenth and Eleventh Ranks. If one can Enlighten Chaos Rules before the assault on the ultimate, it would be greatly beneficial to becoming ultimate,” the Six-Armed Silhouette recounted after contemplation.

“Chaos Rules?” Lin Yuan’s expression grew solemn.

The so-called Chaos Rules meant fusing all rules back to the Origin Source, returning them to Chaos.

In the era Xuanhuang lived in, the notion of spreading one’s own Evolution Path was not prevalent, so to step into the Supreme Being echelon, one had to rely solely on oneself, utilizing every available means.

Normally, fusing the Rule of Time and Space Rules would be the threshold for stepping into the ultimate.

But that itself is incredibly difficult already, trapping countless Eleventh-Rank Life forms. As for fusing all rules and reverting them to Chaos?

Even in Xuanhuang’s era, that was a legend, with no known life form achieving it. It was merely a theoretical method.

Of course, whether it was Enlightening Chaos Rules or spreading one’s own Evolution Path, both were auxiliary to the assault on the ultimate. Even without them, one could still launch an assault on the ultimate, albeit with a lower success rate.

When Xuanhuang made his initial leap to the ultimate, becoming a Supreme Being, he did it by giving his all and having a stroke of good luck.

“Thank you,” Lin Yuan said, nodding slightly.

Others might not achieve it, but that didn’t mean Lin Yuan couldn’t, with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, Enlightening Chaos Rules wasn’t entirely hopeless.

At least it was the only method Lin Yuan currently knew of that could greatly benefit one’s assault on the ultimate.

After all, even spreading one’s own Evolution Path simply provided benefits, as opposed to great benefits, when making the ultimate leap.

Certainly, the difficulty of the two wasn’t on the same level. Spreading one’s own Evolution Path? Clearly, it was somewhat less challenging.

“However, spreading one’s own Evolution Path not only helps with the ultimate leap but is also beneficial to cultivation after stepping into the Twelfth Rank, helping stabilize one’s imprint of existence,” Lin Yuan thought silently.

In any case, he wouldn’t give up preaching. He would spread his own Evolution Path not only throughout the Main Universe but also in other dimensions and worlds.

This act of spreading one’s “Dao” to the Myriad Realms of the Heavens, Lin Yuan faintly felt, held infinite benefits for his future.

…

Virtual World.

The wedding of Lin Yi and Xia Keren came to a close.

With the influence of the Human the Xia Family and the Galaxy Master, this high-profile wedding impacted human civilization significantly, with countless “internet celebrities” and “livestreamers” from the Virtual World paying a hefty price for the chance to participate.

When the wedding ended,

Lin Yuan held a private gathering with some Tenth Rank Evolvers who attended the wedding.

“Hahahaha, I’ve long heard of the Galaxy Master’s great name. Today, I finally get to meet you,” a one-armed man laughed heartily.

His left sleeve fluttered empty, leaving only his right hand visible. With human civilization’s technology, not only could a missing left hand be easily regenerated, but even if only the head remained, a complete body could be effortlessly recreated.

Moreover, as a Tenth Rank Evolver, growing back his left hand was as trivial as could be.

However, the one-armed man’s left hand had been severed by a formidable enemy from the Insect Race.

Ever since then, the one-armed man had chosen not to allow his severed limb to regrow, as a reminder to himself.

At the Tenth Rank level, the clash of fused rules mattered far more than whether one had a missing limb or not.

Otherwise, wouldn’t the many-armed races in the universe be at a huge advantage?

“I’ve also heard of the name of the Black Star Lord,” Lin Yuan immediately responded.

The one-armed man was known as the Black Star Lord, but of course, Black Star Lord was just a moniker, just as Lin Yuan was known as the Galaxy Master.

Black Star Lord was an extremely fearsome Tenth Rank powerhouse, who had long been slotted into the ‘Grade A’ threat list.

Besides, the Black Star Lord originated from one of the nine Evolution Towers, the Black Origin Tower.

“Galaxy Master, it’s our first meeting,” a woman with green hair said with a smile.

“Lustrous Star Master, when you dominated our human civilization for an era, I wasn’t even born,” Lin Yuan said with emotion, “Back then, I really regarded the Lustrous Star Master as my goal.”

Lustrous Star Master was also a peerless genius from a certain era of human civilization, with a rare special physique and unparalleled potential in her Bloodline Power, which made her an outstanding figure from First Rank to Ninth Rank.

During her Ninth Rank, the Lustrous Star Master opened up nearly 60 million layers in her spatial realm, making her the strongest Ninth Rank of that era among the Ten Thousand Universe Races.

After stepping into the Tenth Rank, in less than a million years, the Lustrous Star Master had reached ‘Grade A’ level.

“Taking me as a goal?” the Lustrous Star Master sighed, “Galaxy Master, you really know how to joke.”

“Hahahaha, the number of spatial layers opened by the Galaxy Master is several times that of the Lustrous, isn’t it? With you saying that, the Lustrous might not be able to stay on her feet,” a gaunt old man, skeletal in appearance, chuckled.

He too was Grade A Tier 10, once a bright figure in the annals of human civilization.

Lin Yuan looked at the dozens of Tenth Rank individuals attending the gathering. The least among them was a ‘Grade B’ Tenth Rank, each no less than a major figure in human civilization, all with hopes of stepping into Tier 11 in the future.
